_comment: Runtime knobs for fl-county-watch. Cadence is NOT read by the pipeline; the scheduler (GitHub Actions / cron) owns frequency. Two gates open the 3-hourly cron: the repository variable ELECTION_WINDOW (manual override, either direction) or the automatic date window in the workflow's gate step. The election_window field below MIRRORS the repo variable for documentation only and is not read by anything. `workers` applies to plain fetches only - headless renders are always serialized to protect determinism.

cadence.note: baseline = daily 08:00 UTC; election window = every 3 hours. The auto window raises cadence for the 2026 general without needing the variable flipped: it opens before mandatory early voting (Oct 24-31) and closes two weeks after election day so the post-election takedown curve is captured. Authoritative values live in .github/workflows/snapshot.yml; these are documentation.
